# The analyst finds that the alert needs no action. The desk tells the ops system, writes nothing, pages nobody for an approval, and closes the incident.
# The analyst also notes a problem in the procedure, and the desk files it as an item for the owner of the procedure.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

incidentinit
incidentfakes
subst home/.incident/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env INCIDENT_DIR=$WORK/ops
env INCIDENT_MINUTE_SECONDS=60
env INCIDENT_ROUNDS=2
env INCIDENT_ROUND_SECONDS=1

stdin alert.json
exec sh ops/scripts/spool-alert.sh
exec obeereal item add incident watch-1 --title 'Watch' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run watch-1 incident --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item watch-1 finished'

grep '^incident-2 no-action$' status.log
! exists writes.log
grep -count=1 '^incident-2 primary$' pages.log
! grep secondary pages.log
! grep postmortem calls.log
exec obeereal status
stdout 'item-incident-2-r1\tdone'
exec obeereal item list incident
stdout '\[procedure-owner\] sev1: Checkout errors'

-- body.txt --
The watch.
-- alert.json --
{"fingerprint":"n1","severity":"sev1","title":"Checkout errors","service":"checkout","detail":"NOACTION PROCNOTE the error rate is back to normal"}
-- home/.incident/config --
OPS_API=http://ops.test
SPOOL=@WORK@/home/.incident/spool
INC_POLL=1
INC_MINUTE=1
INC_TICK=1
-- home/.incident/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
-- resp/_services_checkout_metrics --
{"error_rate":0.0}
-- resp/_services_checkout_deploys --
[]
-- resp/_services_checkout_logs --
line one
-- resp/_services_checkout_state --
{"version":"v413","replicas":3}
-- resp/_services_checkout_health --
{"healthy":true}
